choices.en: guanyin didn't help wukong fix the ginseng tree.
choices.zh: 观音没有帮助悟空修理人参果树。

choices.en: lady whitebone had been waiting for the tang monk.
choices.zh: 白骨夫人一直在等待唐僧。

choices.en: bajie apologized for not believing wukong.
choices.zh: 八戒为不相信悟空而道歉。

answer_evidence.quote: A short while later, Wukong and Guanyin arrived at the abbey.
Guanyin told Wukong, Bajie, and Wujing to stand the tree back up.
Guanyin rose into the air and poured the dew over the ginseng tree.
The tree's color came back, and new leaves and fruit grew.
Up ahead, an evil spirit named Lady Whitebone sat by the side of the road.
She had been waiting by the road for years.

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: how long did wukong have to fix the ginseng tree?
prompt.zh: 悟空修理人参树花了多长时间？

choices.en: until the end of the day
until the end of the week
until the end of the month

answer_evidence.quote: The Great Immortal thought for a moment.
"Okay, Wukong. I will give you until the end of the day to fix my ginseng tree. If you can't, the Tang Monk goes into the frying pan."
"Bodhisattva!" cried the monkey. "I need your help! A Daoist named the Great Immortal is going to fry the Tang Monk. I have until the end of the day to fix his ginseng tree."

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: what was the power of the magic dew?
prompt.zh: 魔法露水的力量是什么？

choices.en: it could bring spirit plants back to life.
choices.zh: 它可以让灵魂植物复活。

choices.en: it could save the tang monk from evil.
choices.zh: 它可以拯救唐僧免于邪恶。

choices.en: it could defeat the great immortal.

answer_evidence.quote: "It can bring spirit plants, such as the ginseng tree, back to life."

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: what did the great immortal decide to do?

choices.en: share the ginseng fruit with everyone
teach wukong to control his anger
eat the tang monk and bajie

answer_evidence.quote: Soon the tree looked just as it had the day before.
To thank everyone, the Great Immortal decided to host a feast.
"I would like to share some ginseng fruit with everyone here," he said.
The two priests brought in trays of ginseng fruits.

prompt.en: what happened when the tang monk ate the fruit?
prompt.zh: 唐僧吃了果子后发生了什么？

choices.en: it no longer looked like a baby.
choices.zh: 它看起来不再像婴儿了。

answer_evidence.quote: "What happened to the tree?" asked Guanyin.
